name: dsm-soil
description: Digital soil mapping, soil-quality indexing and soil spatial-analysis skills forged from the DSM knowledge wiki: soil quality & health indexing (SQI/SHI), fertility mapping, prediction uncertainty (AOA/LPD/MC), sampling design, ML for soil, end-to-end DSM workflow, map validation, RothC temporal modelling, hybrid process+ML SOC, SOC-stock MRV, and spatial statistics on areal data.
